data.name: Occult Cleanup Agency
data.detailed_description:
Occult Cleanup Agency is a deductive, paranormal-cleaning sim steeped in pre-millennial paranoia and weird-workplace mystery. As a Maintenance Agent you must explore the eerie aftermath of paranormal events, piece together the disturbing truth on your caseboard, and then clean it all away so that nobody else ever finds out

Learn the Truth

Use your camera to photograph the chilling scenes, tragic victims, and curious evidence left behind at Incident Sites. Investigate collected evidence closely to reveal unique insights and key casewords. Add them all to your ever expanding caseboard to discover what REALLY happened.

Clean it Away

As an Agency employee you’re sworn to hide these awful truths from the public for the greater good. Use your cleaning skills to wipe away the blood, clear the bodies, and replace everything JUST how it was before the unspeakable things occurred.

Embrace the Paranormal

A Maintenance Agent must wield unconventional tools even if they don’t fully understand them. Burn away roots that have forced their way into our world. Sanctify cursed objects with salt-ritual spray. Capture forbidden sigils with your camera’s aberration lens. Use your heightened senses to untangle the awful mess of incident sites.

Pull a Shift

Spend your downtime between incidents learning all about your workplace. Why do covens play such a big part? Is Banishment normally located below HR? What is an ESP survey and why must it occur behind a one-way mirror? Is Divination Appreciation Day a standard holiday? Why can’t you remember why you were away for so long? That seems important…

Stop Asking Questions

Unless they have been mandated via form YX5667 and cleared by your department supervisor.

Join the Agency

Occult Cleanup Agency is a single-player experience promising over 15 hours of puzzling deductions, satisfying cleaning, and unravelling mysteries - all against a background of lurking horror.

The Agency needs someone just like you. Will you step up?

data.short_description: Grab your camera, pack your power-washer, and clear off the caseboard - you’re back on the nightshift for the Agency and it’s your job to investigate, catalogue, and then meticulously clean away the remnants of paranormal and occult incidents.
